mapper.select: SELECT FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND active_flag = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, ticket_id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'APPROVED', audited_by = #{auditedBy}, audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, audited_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{auditedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'REJECTED', active_flag = NULL, audited_by = #{auditedBy}, audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, audited_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{auditedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'BUYER_SHIPPED', return_tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, buyer_shipped_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{buyerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND after_sale_type IN ('RETURN_REFUND', 'EXCHANGE') AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'SELLER_RECEIVED', audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{sellerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'BUYER_SHIPPED' AND after_sale_type = 'RETURN_REFUND' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'REFUNDED', active_flag = NULL, refund_id = #{refundId}, audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{sellerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND after_sale_type = 'REFUND_ONLY' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'REFUNDED', active_flag = NULL, refund_id = #{refundId}, audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{sellerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'SELLER_RECEIVED' AND after_sale_type = 'RETURN_REFUND' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = 'COMPLETED', active_flag = NULL, exchange_tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, audit_remark = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, seller_shipped_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{sellerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'BUYER_SHIPPED' AND after_sale_type = 'EXCHANGE' AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND is_deleted = 0
